author: Mantreswara
text: When Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, or Saturn occupies a Kendra in its own sign or exaltation sign, Ruchaka, Bhadra, Hamsa, Malavya, or Sasa Yoga is generated respectively. These yogas bestow majestic charisma, mastery in specialized vocations, long life, and leadership over communities and institutions.

author: Mantreswara
text: The 7th house and Venus judge marital joy, trade contracts, and public partnerships. When the 7th lord is situated in its own house, in a friend's sign, or with Jupiter, the partner is noble, loyal, supportive, and catalytic to the native's prosperity.

author: Mantreswara
text: When Jupiter is in a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) from the Moon, Gajakesari Yoga is formed. The native becomes brilliant, respected, victorious over opposition, wealthy, and protected by universal goodwill throughout life.

author: Mantreswara
text: Saturn's transit over the 12th, 1st, and 2nd houses from natal Moon represents the seven-and-a-half year cycle of inner transformation. It disciplines the ego, forces structural reassessment of life goals, and ultimately builds unbreakable resilience.
